title: The Edge-based Contiguous p-median Problem with Connections to Logistics Districting
abstract: arXiv:2608.11230v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper introduces the edge-based contiguous p-median (ECpM) problem to partition the roads in a network into a given number of compact and contiguous territories. Two binary programming models are introduced, both of which incorporate a network distance. The first model requires an exponential number of cut set-based constraints to model contiguity; it is paired with a separation scheme that usually generates only a small number of these constraints, namely, a branch-and-cut (B&C) algorithm. The second model utilizes a polynomial number of shortest-path constraints to model contiguity and can be solved with off-the-shelf solvers. The respective solution approaches are tested on road networks with over 2,700 nodes and close to 3,400 edges, yielding models with over 9.6 million binary variables. translated_title: 基于边界的连续p-中位问题及其与物流分区的关系
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11230v1 公告类型：新 摘要：本文介绍了基于边界的连续p-中位（ECpM）问题，旨在将网络中的道路划分为给定数量的紧凑且连续的领地。提出了两种二进制规划模型，均包含网络距离。第一个模型需要指数数量的割集约束来建模连续性；它配有一个分离方案，通常只生成少量这些约束，即分支切割（B&C）算法。第二个模型利用多项式数量的最短路径约束来建模连续性，并可通过现成求解器求解。各自解决方案在具有超过2，700个节点和接近3，400条边的道路网络上进行测试，生成的模型拥有超过960万个二进制变量。通过标准分支定界求解基于最短路径连续性（SPC）约束的模型，在计算时间上实现了加速。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于边界的连续p-中位问题，通过两种二进制编程模型和高效算法，在大型道路网络上实现紧凑连续分区的快速求解。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the edge-based contiguous p-median problem, proposing two binary programming models with efficient algorithms to achieve fast partitioning of large road networks into compact and contiguous territories.
